topics.name: Fashion
topics.text:
brand = the name given to a product by the company that makes it
clothing = clothes or garments in general
compliment = a remark that shows admiration or approval
frames = the plastic or metal structure holding lenses in glasses
glamorous = attractive, elegant and exciting
hoodie = a warm casual sweatshirt with a hood
layer = an extra piece or level of clothing worn over another
range = a variety or selection of different products
sleeve = the part of a garment that covers the arm
stylish = fashionable, attractive and elegant
handbag = a small bag used for carrying personal items like money and keys
jumper = a warm knitted piece of clothing worn on the upper body
raincoat = a waterproof coat worn to protect you from rain

The shop will ______ your order directly to your house. = deliver
He wore a ______ white shirt without any pattern or logos. = plain
Check the ______ to see how much the jacket costs. = price tag
She was wearing a pair of ______ jeans with holes at the knees. = ripped
She wore a ______ top because it was very hot outside. = sleeveless
That dark green coat really ______ you. = suit
Can I ______ my blue scarf for your red one? = swap
Pull up the ______ on your jacket so you don't get cold. = zip
He tightened his leather ______. = belt
Make sure you wear warm ______. = boots
Don't forget your ______ because it's freezing outside. = gloves
Put on your ______ before you go outside. = jacket
Wrap a warm wool ______ around your neck. = scarf
Open your ______ so you don't get wet in the rain. = umbrella

topics.name: Games
topics.text:
to assess = to judge how good or serious something is
to boost = to make something increase or improve
to cheat = to break the rules in order to win
to daydream = to think about nice things instead of paying attention
to draw a conclusion = to decide something after thinking about the facts
It took me an hour to ______ the answer to the puzzle. = figure out
to focus = to give all your attention to one thing
to gamble = to risk money on the result of a game or event
You won't win if you don't ______ to learn the rules. = make an effort
to read someone's mind = to know what another person is thinking
to recall = to remember something from the past
to recognise = to know someone or something because you have seen them before
to remind = to help someone remember something
to suspect = to think that someone has done something wrong
Let's ______ rolling the dice so everyone can play. = take turns
I need time to ______ your offer before I decide. = think over
dice = small cubes with dots that you throw in games
board game = a game played on a flat surface with pieces
score = the number of points in a game
level = one stage of a video game
challenge = something difficult that tests your skills
strategy = a plan to win a game
sound effects = noises added to make a game feel real
snake = a long animal with no legs
ladder = a tool with steps that you use to climb up
to replace = to put something new in the place of something old
to discover = to find something for the first time
* opponent = the person or team you play against
* to bluff = to trick other players by pretending you have a strong position
* tournament = a competition where players or teams play many games to find a winner
* to outwit = to beat someone by being smarter than them
* addictive = so enjoyable that you find it hard to stop

topics.name: Travel
topics.text:
airline = a company that flies passengers in planes
to board = to get on a plane, train or ship
We need to ______ at the hotel before three o'clock. = check in
crew = the people who work on a plane or ship
delay = a situation when something happens later than planned
fabulous = extremely good
flight attendant = a person who looks after passengers on a plane
full board = a hotel price that includes three meals a day
gate = the place in an airport where you get on your plane
half board = a hotel price that includes breakfast and dinner
high season = the busiest and most expensive time of year for holidays
We bought our tickets ______ to get a better price. = in advance
lively = full of energy and activity
luxurious = very comfortable and expensive
We're travelling ______, so we can't spend much money. = on a budget
overcrowded = with too many people in one place
rate = the amount of money you pay for a hotel room each night
unforgettable = so special that you will always remember it
The beach is ______ of our hotel, so we don't need a car. = within walking distance
youth hostel = a cheap place to stay, mostly for young travellers
to book = to arrange and pay for a hotel or ticket before you travel
accommodation = a place where you stay on holiday
tour = a trip around a place to see the sights
destination = the place where you are going
* itinerary = a detailed plan of a trip with places and times
* landmark = a famous building or place that tourists recognise
* jet lag = tiredness after a long flight to a different time zone
* layover = a short stop between two flights
* off the beaten track = in a quiet place that few tourists visit
